incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: node-pool-gpu-14 reported ephemeral storage pressure -> kubelet evicting pods (eviction_threshold reached). Auto-pager sent to oncall.
jamie: grabbing this. oncall here. what env/cluster?
incident-bot: cluster: prod-west, node: gpu-14, reason: imagefs.available < 5%, recent evictions: modelcache-serve-* pods.
jamie: thanks. sasha can you join? looks like modelcache writes + log sprawl.
sasha: on my way. quick check: `kubectl describe node gpu-14` shows large number of pod evictions and kubelet eviction manager triggered. kubelet logs show repeated journal writes about modelcache temp files.
lee: I see `du -sh /var/lib/modelcache/*` on the node returns multiple dirs >30GB each. logrotate appears to have failed last night for a few pods.
maria: any customer-facing errors yet? support-ops, status?
support-ops: increasing 5xx rate detected in prod-west for generation endpoints. Some enterprise tenants seeing 503s and increased latency. tagging customers affected and opening incident ticket.
jamie: root cause hypothesis: modelcache prefetch job + verbose debug logs filled imagefs (ephemeral overlay) so kubelet started evicting pods -> serving pods restart and some hit CUDA init issues when resources scarce, cascade of failures.
sasha: confirmed one pod crashlog: `RuntimeError: CUDA driver not initialized` immediately after restart; followed by OOM on another init path: `std::bad_alloc` in allocator.
jamie: can we stop prefetcher and reduce logging to pause writes? lee can you push a temporary config change to disable prefetch on prod-west node pool?
lee: giving it a try. patching feature flag on configmap: `modelcache.prefetch.enabled=false` and applying to DS. Also patching log level: `LOG_LEVEL=warning` for modelcache container.
dev-bot: deploy started for configmap/modelcache-override in prod-west (sha: abc123). Rolling update to 3/12 pods so far.
sasha: while rolling, we should free space on node to prevent more evictions. jamie, can you SSH and rm stale tmp files? I'll coordinate.
jamie: SSHing. found `/var/log/modelcache/debug.log.202503` huge ~48GB. moving to /tmp and compressing: `gzip -9 debug.log.202503 && mv debug.log.202503.gz /mnt/persist/log-archive/`.
lee: configmap rolled to 6/12 pods. nodes showing decreased write throughput.
incident-bot: notice: kubelet eviction pressure easing on gpu-14.
maria: support-ops, any visible reduction in 5xxs?
support-ops: error rate falling from 4.7% -> 1.2% over last 4m. still elevated for ~30% of requests. notifying customers about partial degradation and mitigation in progress.
jamie: starting controlled restart of serving-runtime on remaining pods to clear hung allocators. command: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serve-runtime -n prod --field-selector spec.nodeName!=gpu-14` to avoid draining still pressured node.
sasha: we should also cordon gpu-14 to avoid new pods landing until we confirm disk state. `kubectl cordon gpu-14` done.
lee: making a temporary increase to eviction threshold? kubelet flag change requires node restart — not ideal right now.
jamie: alternative: move modelcache volumes for new pods to hostpath backed persistent volume in separate tier. Doing a canary: create pod with pvc pointing to fast-ephemeral2.
dev-bot: canary pod started on gpu-12 with modelcache hostpath pvc -> passes health checks.
sasha: logs show that pods restarted on healthy nodes come up cleanly; no CUDA init failures so far. guess the main issue was sudden disk saturation during allocator init windows.
maria: recommend we run a job to purge old compressed logs and rotate daily, and add alert for single file >10GB in imagefs.
jamie: agreed. immediate mitigations done: disabled prefetch, reduced log level, compressed biggest logs, cordoned node, restarted serving on healthy nodes. Next: schedule node reboot after maintenance window to clear kernel-level overlays and restart kubelet.
support-ops: customers notified with interim RCA summary and ETA for full recovery: 2 hours for node maintenance + config rollout. adding follow-up in status page.
lee: opening follow-up ticket for durable fix: move large transient files off imagefs, make prefetch throttled, ensure logrotate exits with status and alerts. assign to eng-runtime.
jamie: handoff to oncall night: sasha will take next watch. summary: cause - modelcache + verbose logs filled imagefs -> kubelet eviction -> pod restarts -> CUDA init/OOM cascade. mitigations applied: prefetch disabled, loglevel lowered, big logs compressed and moved, node cordoned, serving restarted on healthy nodes, customers notified. residual action items in ticket #INC-2248.
sasha: taking handoff. will monitor memory/GPU init errors and 5xx rate. set alert thresholds tighter for imagefs usage and single-file growth.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity reduced to SEV3. follow-up ticket INC-2248 created with assignees eng-runtime:lee, eng-sre:sasha. slack channel: #inc-2248.
jamie: thanks all. leaving notes in the ticket with commands used and exact compressed log filenames for forensics. :white_check_mark:
support-ops: closing customer-facing blurb draft and sending out now. will reopen if any regression.
jamie: handoff complete. good work everyone.
